g.text: Overlap of stool-decreased cellulose-annotated taxa against six null models

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Nulls that draw taxa independently (U1–U4) make the overlap look extreme; nulls that respect how often taxa are reported (U5) and which taxa are reported together (U6) do not.
Observed values are in the first column. Shaded blue: p < 0.05. U1–U3 pair p-values are exact hypergeometric tails; all other p are Monte Carlo. U4
places a random trait on the taxa reported decreased in stool in the three conditions; U5 weights taxa by their reporting frequency in other stool
studies; U6 permutes whole study signatures.

Names are KG-Microbe matrix taxon names; family-and-above nodes carry annotations rolled up from descendants. PD, Parkinson's disease; HIV, HIV infection; CRC, colorectal cancer. BugSigDB 2026-04-24_00:41_UTC;
human profiles; condition and body site from each experiment's own record.
